facts.audience: Orange County residents on time-of-use electricity plans
facts.problem: Home AC activity overlaps the peak-price window on a time-of-use plan
facts.cause: Cooling runs during expensive peak hours instead of before them
facts.solution: Pre-cool the home before peak rates, then raise the thermostat a little during peak hours
facts.outcome: Some cooling can shift away from expensive hours; check your plan's peak times
